results.text: Sitagliptin, a DPP-4 Inhibitor, Effectively Promotes the Healing of Diabetic Foot Ulcer: A Randomized Controlled Trial. This randomized controlled trial (RCT) was designed to evaluate the effects of sitagliptin on diabetic foot ulcers (DFUs). This was a randomized, open-label clinical trial. Efficacy and tolerability of sitagliptin monotherapy in elderly patients with type 2 diabetes: a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial. Type 2 diabetes in the elderly is an important and insufficiently studied public health problem. This study evaluated sitagliptin monotherapy in patients with type 2 diabetes aged ≥ 65 years.
